items.source: PropertyValueConversions provides access to converters that may only be applied to a specific property.
items.translation: PropertyValueConversions 提供对 converters 的访问，这些转换器仅可应用于特定的 property。

items.source: Configuration class used to register a PropertyValueConverter with a SimplePropertyValueConverterRegistry that can be used in PropertyValueConversions.
items.translation: 用于向SimplePropertyValueConverterRegistry注册一个PropertyValueConverter的配置类，该配置类可在PropertyValueConversions中使用。

items.source: Value object holding the actual CustomConversions.StoreConversions and custom converters configured for registration.
items.translation: 包含实际 CustomConversions.StoreConversions 以及为注册而配置的自定义 转换器 的值对象。

items.source: The ValueConversionContext provides access to the store-specific PersistentProperty and allows to call the store-default conversion through the read/write methods.
items.translation: `ValueConversionContext` 接口提供了对特定存储的 `PersistentProperty` 的访问权限，并允许通过读写方法调用存储默认的转换功能。

items.source: A registry of property-specific value converters to convert only specific properties/values of an object.
items.translation: 一个用于转换对象特定属性/值的property-specificvalue converters注册表。

items.source: API to easily set up GenericConverter instances using Java 8 lambdas, mostly in bidirectional fashion for easy registration as custom type converters of the Spring Data mapping subsystem.
items.translation: 一个 API，可轻松使用 Java 8 Lambda 表达式设置 GenericConverter 实例，主要用于双向转换，以便轻松注册为 Spring Data 映射子系统的自定义类型转换器。

items.source: A ConverterBuilder aware of both a reading and writing converter.
items.translation: 一个ConverterBuilder同时知晓读取和写入转换器。

items.source: Interface to represent an intermediate setup step of ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware defining a reading converter first.
items.translation: 接口，用于表示 `ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware` 的中间配置步骤，首先定义读取转换器。

items.source: Interface to represent an intermediate setup step of ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware defining a writing converter first.
items.translation: 接口，用于表示 `ConverterBuilder.ConverterAware` 的中间配置步骤，首先定义写入转换器。

items.source: Value type to capture store-specific extensions to the CustomConversions.
items.translation: 用于捕获针对特定存储的CustomConversions扩展的值类型。

items.source: PropertyValueConverter provides a symmetric way of converting certain properties from domain to store-specific values.
items.translation: PropertyValueConverter 提供了一种对称的方式，用于将某些属性从领域对象转换为特定存储的值。

items.source: A factory providing value converters.
items.translation: 一个提供值转换器的工厂。

items.source: Annotation to clarify intended usage of a Converter as reading converter in case the conversion types leave room for disambiguation.
items.translation: 注释，用于阐明 `Converter` 的预期用途：当转换类型存在歧义时，应将其视为读取转换器。

items.source: Annotation to clarify intended usage of a Converter as writing converter in case the conversion types leave room for disambiguation.
items.translation: 注释以阐明 `Converter` 的预期用途：当转换类型存在歧义时，应编写转换器。

items.source: General purpose conversion framework to read objects from a data store abstraction and write it back.
items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。

items.source: Exposes a reading converter.
items.translation: 暴露一个读取转换器。

items.source: Exposes a writing converter.
items.translation: 暴露一个书写转换器。

items.source: Value object to capture custom conversion.
items.translation: 用于捕获自定义转换的值对象。

items.source: Interface to read object from store specific sources.
items.translation: 用于从特定源读取对象的接口。

items.source: Interface to write objects into store specific sinks.
items.translation: 用于向特定存储写入对象的接口。

items.source: Helper class used to build a fluent API to register how to read a database value into a domain object property.
items.translation: 用于构建流式 API 的辅助类，用于注册如何将数据库值读取到领域对象属性中。

items.source: Helper class used to build up a fluent registration API starting with writing.
items.translation: 用于构建以写入为起点的流式注册 API 的辅助类。

items.source: Interface to abstract implementations of how to access a type alias from a given source or sink.
items.translation: 用于抽象如何从给定源或汇访问类型别名的接口。

items.source: Interface to abstract the mapping from a type alias to the actual type.
items.translation: 用于抽象从类型别名到实际类型的映射的接口。

items.source: Interface to define strategies how to store type information in a store specific sink or source.
items.translation: 定义如何在特定存储库的汇或源中存储类型信息的接口。
